Setting: Overall MFA Capability Coverage At Least 90 Percent
Recommendation: Drive MFA registration coverage above 90% tenant-wide through a registration campaign before enforcing stricter Conditional Access controls, to avoid locking out unregistered users. If the tenant holds Entra ID P2 (or Entra Suite), Identity Protection's Multifactor authentication registration policy (Protect > Multifactor authentication registration policy) is a stronger lever than the campaign alone: once enabled, it gives an unregistered user 14 days to register before actually blocking sign-in, rather than an indefinitely snoozable nudge. This toolkit cannot see whether it's enabled - Graph exposes no property for this policy's configuration, only a sign-in-log attribute (requirementProvider = mfaRegistrationRequiredByIdentityProtectionPolicy) that shows its effect after the fact - so check its state directly in the admin center.
